The '''Observation Ship''' was a patrol vehicle employed by the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the creation, growth and training of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

==Characteristics==
The Observation Ships were shaped like airships, complete with a detachable Observation Gondola hanging underneath. The main observation deck was located midship and a repulsor-array was positioned directly underneath the main hull.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations" />

==History==
Observation Ships were used in the [[clone military education complex]]. They were large, mobile quality-control inspection laboratories that patrolled the Military Complex. Staffed by [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] scientists, these vessels were on the look out not only for problems among [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], but also for ways to improve the cloning and training processes.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations" />
